title: CHUYÊN ĐỀ 3 CÂU HỎI VỀ TỪ CHỈ LƯỢNG V-ACT - ĐỀ LUYỆN TẬP SỐ 2
notes: Chưa có đáp án trong dữ liệu nguồn; hệ thống không chấm điểm đề này.

questions.content: Although the marketing plan seemed flawless, there were ______ logistical issues that forced the team to delay the product launch.
The latest quarterly report indicates that ______ progress has been made in the peace negotiations due to the stubbornness of both parties.
We have interviewed ______ candidates for the managerial role, but none of them possess the specific skillset required for this advanced position.
______ student in the university is required to complete the comprehensive safety training module before accessing the chemistry laboratory.
There is ______ evidence to suggest that the proposed economic policy will have any significant positive impact on the current downturn.
______ of the information provided in the tourist brochure was outdated, which caused significant confusion among the international visitors.
______ politicians have promised to reduce corporate taxes, but only a handful have actually managed to implement such complex measures effectively.
The academic advisor gave us ______ advice on how to structure our thesis proposal, which proved to be incredibly helpful for our research.
______ applicant must submit their updated resume and a personalized cover letter by the end of the business day on Friday.
Sadly, ______ knowledge of indigenous local history was lost when the elderly village historian passed away unexpectedly last winter.
______ the furniture in the abandoned Victorian house was covered in a thick layer of dust and spiderwebs after years of neglect.
We need to find ______ solution to this technical problem because the current workaround is clearly not functioning effectively for the users.
______ employees were laid off last month due to the corporation's sudden financial restructuring and the closure of two regional branches.
______ side of the river is suitable for building a suspension bridge due to the unstable soil conditions detected by the surveyors.
I have visited Paris ______ times over the last decade, but I still find new hidden places to explore during every single trip.
The environmental survey shows that ______ people are fully aware of the long-term consequences of fast fashion consumption on the planet.
There are ______ opportunities for rapid advancement in this multinational company if you are willing to work hard and demonstrate initiative.
______ of the two brothers was able to attend the annual family reunion due to conflicting work schedules and travel restrictions.
We spent ______ time analyzing the statistical data, yet we still could not find a clear correlation between the two variables.
______ witness to the accident was asked to remain at the scene until the police officers arrived to take their official statements.
The sheer ______ of traffic on the highway this morning caused me to miss my international flight to London despite leaving home early.
Despite his extensive experience in sales, he has ______ understanding of modern digital marketing strategies required for this specific role.
Only ______ nations have ratified the new environmental treaty, making it largely ineffective on a global scale without wider support.
______ did I know that the person I was speaking to was actually the CEO of the company I was applying to work for.
There is ______ doubt that climate change is the most pressing issue facing humanity today, as agreed upon by almost all scientists.
______ the students in my advanced physics class have completed their final assignments on time this semester without asking for extensions.
He has two luxury cars in his garage, but he doesn't drive ______ of them because he prefers cycling to work every day.
______ determination is required to succeed in such a highly competitive academic environment where everyone is striving for the top rank.
Please give me ______ minutes to finish proofreading this report before we start the weekly departmental meeting.
______ computer in the research lab has been updated with the latest antivirus software to prevent potential cyber attacks from external sources.
The mechanic checked the front tires and found that ______ of them were punctured and needed immediate replacement for safety reasons.
There isn’t ______ justification for raising the subscription prices without significantly improving the quality of the streaming service.
______ of the participants expressed deep dissatisfaction with the way the international conference was organized and managed this year.
We have two potential options for the venue, but ______ seems suitable for a gathering of this size and importance.
She has written three novels in the past five years, but ______ of them has been accepted by a major publisher yet.
There is ______ hope of finding any more survivors in the rubble after such a devastating magnitude 7.0 earthquake.
______ member of the board of directors voted against the controversial proposal to merge with the rival company.
______ the equipment used in the chemical experiment was expensive and required careful handling by trained professionals.
I have looked for my car keys everywhere, but I can't find them in ______ room of the house despite searching thoroughly.
______ people believe that artificial intelligence will eventually replace human labor in most creative industries within the next decade.
The university library has ______ books on ancient Roman history, but very few on modern political science developments.
______ attention should be paid to the fine print details when you are signing a binding legal contract with a new partner.
There are ______ valid reasons why I decided to resign from my position, but the main one was the lack of professional growth.
Can I have ______ piece of chocolate cake, or is this the last one available in the bakery today?
______ luggage is allowed on the international flight without paying an additional excess baggage fee?
______ of the research findings were published in prestigious international journals, enhancing the university's reputation.
The construction project was delayed because ______ qualified engineers were available to fix the critical technical glitch.
You can choose ______ of the two desserts on the menu; they are both included in the price of the set meal.
Approximately two-thirds of the apple crop ______ spoiled due to the unexpected frost last week.
The latest statistics show that ______ infectious diseases have been completely eradicated in the region over the last century.
